callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to a directory that may contain a code indexing database.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project's code index when the project can be indexed; returns a falsy value when indexing is not possible (e.g., database missing or incompatible).

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: The receiver is an initialized CodeGraphExtractor instance. language is a language key string (e.g., 'javascript'). proj_dir is the project directory path string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each absolute filepath string to a list of (func_name: str, body_text: str) tuples for all functions defined in source files of the given language within the project — body_text is the function's complete source code.
